title: Sentence key on a keyword tableau judged by growing plain and key together across the gap (beam on both strings, 20,000 best key-fragment settings)
k4_result: Stage 1: 1,260,082,200 settings (807,745 alphabets x 5 layouts x 4 forms x 78 key readings); best forced key fragment -4.609 (INALEVENSURPE|IKETILLSSYM), 20,000th -5.730. Stage 2: 19,905 of the 20,000 kept settings 'bridge' (plain and key both above -5.1 over 21..73), so bridging separates nothing. Best joint score after the wide beam -8.069 (plain -3.948, key -4.121), alphabet ANGIOPLEROSIS, A-Z/M, Beaufort, key read KRYPTOS+5: plain LPARTSALMARGEASTNORTHEASTERSIONCONSSTHANGINGANOTHETFORBERLINCLOCKSENTHEINDTHE (word cover 0.71), key THESARENTISAVEONDERSGEUSAGINSERVERSTHETHESAREFORFORESSAARESEXISFONETHESSANDIE (0.47). Neither string reads as English. K4 on each third of the alphabets (matched to the controls): -8.241, -8.231, -8.069.
controls: Shuffled K4s, each on one third of the alphabets (same third as K4's matched run): -8.222, -8.260, -8.277 (19,500-19,625 of 20,000 bridge). Matched K4 vs shuffled per third: -8.241 vs -8.222 (below), -8.231 vs -8.260, -8.069 vs -8.277. K4 with 20,000 random settings instead of the kept list: best -8.768 (77 of 20,000 bridge). The six full-scale noise maxima (3 shuffled, 3 K4 thirds) span -8.28 to -8.07. K4's best is the top of that range, but its strings are gibberish.
planted: 3/6 ranked first and bridged in their own 20,000-alphabet pool (attack 57's Q3 IMPACTUAL and Q1 ACROMIOHUMERAL, rare-word key). Only 2/6 (true joint -8.015, -7.963) are above the best K4/control noise (-8.069). Misses: 57 Q1 CHEMASTHENIA rank 2 (-8.266), 57 Q3 OPPUGNATION rank 7 (-8.191), idea 89's K3+Z-A key rank 12 (-8.476). Stage 1 kept every planted truth: pool ranks 0-2, and against K4's full run they would rank 0-141 of 20,000 kept.
scope_limits: Weak test: the beam makes plain AND key quadgram-English for almost any setting (noise joint -8.07 to -8.28 vs true settings -7.96 to -8.48), so only a key and message that are unusually strong on the big quadgram model would stand out. Planted power was 2/6 against full-scale noise. Alphabets: dictionary keyword alphabets with their two transposition mixes plus idea 89's 140,752 non-keyword orders; other alphabets are not covered. Five layouts, four forms, 78 key readings. Shuffled controls ran on a third of the alphabets each, and K4 was rerun on the same thirds for a matched comparison. Not covered: German keys, keys of numbers or non-words, keys that are not English on a quadgram model, and wrong clue letters. Beam widths were 20 (all kept) and 300 (best 200), so a deeper search could find higher scores for both truth and noise.

negative.family: running key / sentence key on keyword tableaux
negative.hypothesis: K4 is an English sentence key on a keyword tableau, and growing plain and key together from the clues across the 29-letter gap would make the true setting stand out where the 24 forced key letters alone could not.
negative.scope: 807,745 alphabets (666,993 dictionary keyword alphabets with transposition-mixed forms + 140,752 non-keyword orders) x 5 layouts x 4 forms (Vig, Beau, variant, DIANA) x key read as A-Z/M/KRYPTOS[s+c], c=0..25; best 20,000 by forced key letters; beam width 20 over the gap, width 300 (plus 12 letters on each side) on the best 200; big quadgram model on plain + key.
negative.outcome: No signal: K4 best joint -8.069 with unreadable plain and key (matched shuffled thirds -8.222/-8.260/-8.277; K4 on the same thirds -8.241/-8.231/-8.069; random settings -8.768); 99.5% of kept settings 'bridge' (controls 97.5-98%). Planted: 3/6 ranked first in their pool, only 2/6 above full-scale noise, so the test has low power.

follow_ups: The bridge needs a stronger language model than quadgrams to be decisive (word-level or 5-gram trained on general English, built offline into data/). With quadgrams the beam makes pseudo-English on both sides for any setting.

Re-run the three K4 third-3 leaders (ANGIOPLEROSIS A-Z/M Beaufort KRYPTOS+5 and neighbours) with a much wider beam or an exact Viterbi over the 17,576 plain-trigram states. If truth and noise both rise, that settles the -8.069 outlier for good.
